name: Monday Social / Recovery Run
description: Our standard Monday run, from Forest Hills through the SW Corridor and around Jamaica Pond.

name: Tuesday Morning Run
description: Our standard Tuesday morning route, from the Jamaica Pond Boathouse along the Emerald Necklace to the Landmark Center and back.

name: Jamaica Pond Loop
description: A lap around Jamaica Pond is about 1.5 miles, perfect for an easy loop, a warmup, or adding extra distance before or after a group run.

name: Bussey Hill Repeats
description: A nice climb up and around the Arboretum's Bussey Hill - great views of the Boston skyline at the top!

name: Saturday Franklin Park Four
description: A Saturday long run option that heads from Forest Hills into Franklin Park before returning to J.P. Licks.

name: Saturday Arboretum Hills
description: A Saturday Arboretum route with rolling climbs, especially lovely in spring when the path passes the Arboretum's famous lilacs.

name: Saturday Franklin Park Five
description: A Franklin Park Saturday long run route with an added loop near the Zoo / White Stadium.

name: Saturday Muddy River to Landmark Center
description: A longer Saturday route along the Emerald Necklace to the Landmark Center and back.

name: Saturday Double Reservoir Loop
description: A longer Saturday route linking Jamaica Pond, the Arboretum, and a nearby reservoir.

name: Public Garden and Emerald Necklace Long Run
description: A big long-run route that carries the Emerald Necklace all the way toward the Public Garden before looping back.
